entry.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
entry.summary: While recent language models have the ability to take long contexts as input, relatively little is known about how well they use longer context. We analyze performance on two tasks.

entry.title: Fine-Tuning or Retrieval? Comparing Knowledge Injection in LLMs
entry.summary: Large language models encode a vast amount of factual knowledge. We compare fine-tuning with retrieval-augmented generation.
